items.title: FBI, Cisco Warn of Russian Attacks on 7-Year-Old Flaw

items.title: ZDI-CAN-25441: IceWarp
items.description: A CVSS score 8.8 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H severity vulnerability discovered by 'Nicolas Chatelain' was reported to the affected vendor on: 2025-08-20, 0 days ago. The vendor is given until 2025-12-18 to publish a fix or workaround. Once the vendor has created and tested a patch we will coordinate the release of a public advisory.
